svg.title: Capacity and memory pressure
svg.desc: Replies have a 64 MiB server cap; SDK clients default to a smaller 16 MiB cap. Idle socket reads/writes have a 30-second timeout. Admission failures are explicit errors; retry only when appropriate, rather than opening unlimited connections. Connection handling still uses one thread per accepted connection, bounded by the configured limit.
